functions.description: Parse base syslog structure: timestamp, host, pid, and TimeMachine message body

Extract embedded key=value pairs (epoch, nodeUuid, records, sizeBytes, durationMs, oldMasterUuid, newMasterUuid, errno, sourceUser, sourceIp, action, expected, actual, file, evictedUuid, reason, exception, heapUsedMb, heapMaxMb) from the message body
Normalize user and src_ip field names from extracted kvp fields
Classify severity and event_type based on message content

add.name: event_type
add.value: message.match(/Snapshot dump initiated/) ? 'dump_initiated' : message.match(/Dump completed successfully/) ? 'dump_completed' : message.match(/Node membership update/) ? 'membership_update' : message.match(/Unauthorized access/) ? 'unauthorized_access' : message.match(/Node evicted/) ? 'node_evicted' : message.match(/checksum mismatch/) ? 'checksum_mismatch' : message.match(/Failed to write dump file/) ? 'dump_write_failure' : message.match(/serialization failed/) ? 'serialization_failure' : message.match(/Slow response/) ? 'slow_response' : 'other'
